title: zesty springy grilled mexican pork tacos al pastor
description: tender pork, sweet molasses, and fresh cilantro come together in this vibrant, spring-inspired recipe. perfect for a weeknight dinner or weekend gathering.
instructions: preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
in a small bowl, whisk together the molasses, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
add the pork to the marinade and mix to coat.
cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
remove the pork from the marinade and cook on the grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
transfer the pork to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly.
while the pork is cooking, heat the lard or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the onion and pineapple to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is caramelized and the pineapple is tender.
warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.

assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of the pork onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the onion and pineapple mixture, and finishing with a sprinkle of cilantro and a dash of korean chili flakes.
